name: GenQA
intro: GenQA 不是独立数据集或论文，而是 OLMo 3 报告与官方 OLMES 配置中 OlmoBaseEval 的九任务宏平均能力组，聚合排序选择/续写与生成式短答案问答。
build_method: 模型排名聚类, 任务格式对齐, 官方九任务套件聚合
task_type: 基础模型问答聚合, 排序选择与短答案生成
eval_feature: 九任务宏平均, 任务级few-shot协议, 准确率与答案库F1
task_type_en: Aggregated Base-model QA, Rank-choice and Short-answer Generation
build_method_en: Model-ranking Clustering, Task-format Alignment, Official Nine-task Suite Aggregation
eval_feature_en: Nine-task Macro Average, Task-specific Few-shot Protocols, Accuracy and Answer-bank F1
intro_en: GenQA is not a standalone dataset or paper. It is the nine-task macro-averaged OlmoBaseEval capability group defined in the OLMo 3 report and official OLMES configuration, aggregating rank-choice/continuation and generative short-answer QA.
scale_en: Nine tasks; BasicSkills contains six subtasks
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.13961 and the official OLMES TASK_SUITE_CONFIGS entry olmo3:base:gen. OLMo 3 pools about 23K benchmark results from 70 open-weight models, applies Ward hierarchical clustering to group tasks with similar model rankings, then aligns clusters with task format. GenQA is the resulting nine-task macro-average: HellaSwag, WinoGrande, LAMBADA, BasicSkills (six subtasks), DROP, Jeopardy, NaturalQs, SQuAD, and CoQA. Rank-choice/continuation tasks use their task-defined accuracy variants; short-answer tasks use F1 against answer banks. Most tasks are 5-shot, LAMBADA is 0-shot, and CoQA uses built-in examples; generative tasks use temperature 0 and top-p 1 with 50 or 100 output tokens. The report documents incomplete answer banks as a false-negative limitation and treats Gen2MC as a separate remedy, not part of GenQA.
